reference_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN start_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN '2024-H1'
            WHEN start_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-H2'
            WHEN start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-H1'
            WHEN start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN '2025-H2'
       END AS half_year,
       COUNT(*) AS n_promotions,
       AVG(discount_pct) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM promotions
GROUP BY half_year
alternatives: SELECT CASE WHEN start_date < DATE '2024-07-01' THEN '2024-H1' WHEN start_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN '2024-H2' WHEN start_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN '2025-H1' ELSE '2025-H2' END AS half_year, COUNT(*) AS n_promotions, AVG(discount_pct) AS avg_discount_pct FROM promotions GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN start_date <= '2024-06-30' THEN '2024-H1' WHEN start_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-H2' WHEN start_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-H1' ELSE '2025-H2' END AS half_year, COUNT(promo_id) AS n_promotions, AVG(discount_pct) AS avg_discount_pct FROM promotions GROUP BY CASE WHEN start_date <= '2024-06-30' THEN '2024-H1' WHEN start_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-H2' WHEN start_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-H1' ELSE '2025-H2' END
